title: TermLoop command aliases
description: Bind short aliases to commands. Typing /<alias> in a TermLoop terminal runs the bound command.

additionalProperties.description: A command alias, triggered in a TermLoop terminal by typing /<alias-name>.

description.description: Shown in the "TermLoop: Insert Command Alias" picker.

command.description: The command to run. A single string runs everywhere; an object lets it differ per connection.

oneOf.description: Runs the same command for every connection.
Keys are connection names or ids; "default" is used when nothing more specific matches.

default.description: Used when no connection-specific entry matches.
